title: Roll call of older drummers: Lacey, Willigan, Zongo, Faso, Goldston
summary: Frazier lists drummers of earlier days and comments on Arthur Hogan, Faso (similar to Red Happy) and others.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah. Do you remember any other drummers, old drummers?
Yeah, no, let me see. It was like Mack Lacey. We had Mack Lacey, who was a good old drummer. We had Willigans.
Who was that?
Willigans. Oh, James Willigans. Willigans, yeah. You just played with Dumaine. Lacey Dumaine, that's right. And, well, you heard of Alfred William.
Yeah, Alfred William.
You heard of Abby Foster. You heard of Arthur Hogan.
Oh, was he playing in them days?
Yeah, he was playing. He used to call them Zongo, for nickname. Yeah? Like they called me, sorry, Zong. Everybody called him Zong.
What kind of stuff did he play?
He was a pretty fair drummer. He used to play a lot with Chris Kelly and them different bands. Then we had another one with my favorite in them days was Faso.
Oh, yeah.
I don't ever know his full name. I always called him Faso. Faso.
What kind of stuff did he play?
He was a good drummer.
Same kind of stuff like you were playing, right?
The drummer's similar to Happy, Red Happy.
Yeah.
Similar to Red Happy, Faso. He's similar to Red Happy. Fast drummer. He played with Chris Kelly Band, too.
Yeah?
And we had, let's see, well, you heard of Happy Goldstein.
Oh, yeah, Happy. He was playing in them days.
Yeah, he was playing in them days. Oh, yeah. Happy.
